title: Mara and the Machine
author: Beatrix Delacroix
blurb: Tamsin Okonkwo, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
